content.title: HUB Security secures EUR 20M contract from European financial institution
content.summary: HUB Cyber Security has been selected by Cassa di Risparmio della Repubblica di San Marino to execute a comprehensive EUR 20M digital banking and infrastructure modernization initiative. The Bank is the oldest financial institution in San Marino. The Project remains subject to regulatory approvals and the execution of a definitive agreement.
